segments.normalizedSource: ```swift extension AssetEntity: Transferable { struct AssetQuery: EntityQuery { @Dependency var library: MediaLibrary @MainActor func entities(for identifiers: [AssetEntity.ID]) async throws -> [AssetEntity] { library.assets(for: identifiers).map(\.entity) } @MainActor func suggestedEntities() async throws -> [AssetEntity] { // Suggest the first three assets in the photo library. library.assets.prefix(3).map(\.entity) } } static var transferRepresentation: some TransferRepresentation { DataRepresentation(exportedContentType: .png) { entity in try await entity.asset.pngData() } } } ```
